title: Agent hook payload v1
description: One event pushed by a coding agent's hook into the bar's mission control. Frozen contract (Stage 0); not implemented.

v.description: Schema version. Breaking changes bump it; the receiver ignores versions it does not know.

id.description: Matches the usage record id in ~/.local/state/omarchy/agents/usage/<id>.json (claude, codex, grok, ...).

name.description: Display name; the receiver falls back to the usage record's name.

id.description: Stable for the life of one agent session; the receiver keys running agents by agent.id + session.id.

cwd.description: Working directory. Shown as the project's folder name only.

pid.description: Agent process id, used to drop a session whose process is gone.

window.description: Hyprland window address that hosts the session, so mission control can focus it.

state.description: Where the session is now. 'waiting' means the agent needs the user (permission, question, finished turn) and drives the amber dot.

at.description: When the event happened (ISO 8601, with offset).

message.description: Short human line, e.g. the tool name or the question. No secrets, no file contents.

tokens.description: Optional per-turn counts. Limits stay in the usage records; hooks never report limits.
